subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should this PR become the sole canonical fix for the crash-loop SecretRef ordering bug, replacing the overlapping implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405?
rationale: Both PRs now target the same source/assignment invariant, but this branch is currently mergeable, has exact-head proof, and has no remaining correctness finding; selecting one implementation is an ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Select this PR
